title: Pentaryn Drop Bin
description: An append-only ledger of every item that leaves a character. Records Item Piles drops to the ground and outright deletions from a sheet, in the order they happened, with the item's complete source data — so a two-hander dropped in a corridor three sessions ago can be handed back exactly as it was. Writes to a world setting and mirrors to assets/drop-bin/drop-log.json. GM is the only writer; player clients route their entries through socketlib. Exposes game.pentaryn.dropbin.
